sources.title: Introduction | Camoufox
sources.snippet: AI automations need to run several agents in parallel. Camoufox is a debloated Firefox build stripped of telemetry, background services, and UI overhead running at ~200MB vs Chrome's 800MB+.

sources.title: GitHub - daijro/camoufox: Anti-detect browser
sources.snippet: Introduction Camoufox is a Firefox fork engineered for web scraping and AI agents. It is headless, undetectable, and optimized to run at scale. Every run gets a fresh identity drawn from the real-world distribution of devices, so it blends into normal traffic instead of standing out.
